clips.title: The story
paras: Lord Cobrahn, formerly the night elf druid Jarlaxla, is one of the corrupted Druids of the Fang lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns. Once renowned within the Cenarion Circle for his mastery of shapeshifting, he succumbed to the nightmare infecting the cavern springs. Renaming himself after his new lethal guise, Cobrahn now commands broods of deviate serpents and defends the twisted labyrinth.

Before adopting the moniker Lord Cobrahn, Jarlaxla was a respected member of the Cenarion Circle, celebrated among his fellow druids for his extraordinary skill in channeling animal forms. When Naralex ventured into the Wailing Caverns beneath the Barrens hoping to tap their underground springs and restore lush life to the arid wastes, Jarlaxla accompanied him. However, when Naralex's Emerald Dream communion decayed into a twisting nightmare, Jarlaxla's mind shattered alongside his brothers.
